steps.what: Define the research question, inclusion limits and search terms
Run internet and library searches and inspect the returned source records
inputs: library catalogue and scholarly search results

steps.what: Read original sources and judge relevance, methods and evidential limits
outputs: checked source selections and human-written annotations

steps.what: Assemble the bibliography and source annotations from checked records
inputs: checked source selections and human-written annotations
outputs: complete bibliography and annotated source list

steps.what: Approve the completed source list against original citations and annotations
inputs: complete bibliography and annotated source list

steps.what: Save the approved source list in the existing study folder

tasks.design: Configure saved searches in {OTHER}, meaning library and scholarly search tools, and citation export into {DOCS}. The assistant still reads original sources and writes the substantive annotations; no generated citation is accepted as a source.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated query setup and citation formatting can consume time when native saved searches and citation styles are unused.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing search alerts, metadata export and bibliography formatting can reuse checked source records.
tasks.still_hard: Source quality, access restrictions and conflicting findings need human judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant connects methods and findings to the investigator's question.

ambition.what: Repeat a defined literature search when new evidence appears.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1–3 for library access and investigator agreement

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: scholarly search tools and reference managers can save searches, export citation metadata and format bibliographies.

assumptions: Provisional 100-hour work scenario, not an observed baseline or a time-share prior.
The investigator supplies an actual question; source reading and annotation authoring remain in s1 and s3.
Use licensed native search and citation features first. If already configured, the corresponding savings are zero.
A same-folder save takes approximately no time today and receives no saving; the schema's 1% save allocation is fully retained.
unknowns: Existing saved searches and reference-management coverage
research_questions: How much query setup and citation formatting remains after native configuration?

already_counted.description: Check final citations and annotations against original sources

incremental.description: Maintain search scope, citation export settings and exceptions

approvals.approved_version: approved final source list; any edit requires renewed s5 approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Scenario gross saving is 20 hours: 12 in search setup/result handling and 8 in bibliography assembly. Two hours upkeep gives central net 18%; four extra hours resolving source metadata gives high 14%. Low zero if native features already remove this work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select the actual research findings and decide what the audience needs to understand
Prepare presentation figures and slides from checked tables and selected interpretation
Check and approve the complete presentation including limitations and audience suitability
Present the approved research findings to the group
Answer audience questions using the study's actual evidence and acknowledge unknowns
outputs: live answers and actual follow-up commitments

steps.what: Record actual questions and follow-up commitments and check their accuracy
inputs: live answers and actual follow-up commitments

steps.what: Save the checked follow-up note in the study folder

tasks.design: Use native templates in {DOCS} and reusable figures in {BI} to assemble a presentation from checked results. The assistant chooses the interpretation, checks the finished slides and presents them; actual questions and commitments are recorded after the discussion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated figure formatting and slide assembly can take time even with settled study results.
tasks.enabler_now: Reusable chart views and presentation layouts can populate a complete draft without generating scientific interpretation.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining uncertainty and responding to unexpected questions remain human work.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant notices misunderstanding and adapts the explanation to the group.

ambition.what: Prepare a suitable presentation for another audience using the same checked findings.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1–3 for study disclosure and audience access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: presentation templates and reusable chart exports can reduce repeated figure and slide formatting.

assumptions: All shares and savings are provisional work-design scenarios, not measured current practice.
Checked findings are produced by the study; selecting and interpreting them is counted in s1.
No model writes unsupplied conclusions. Native formatting is configured first.
Presentation is to an authorised outside group; internal delivery changes the authority classification, not the labour saving.
The save in s7 is approximately zero time today; its minimum schema allocation is fully retained.
Any separate written reply or later distribution needs its own completed draft, approval and send; neither is silently included here.
unknowns: How much slide work existing templates already cover
research_questions: Which presentation assembly steps remain repetitive with approved findings?

already_counted.description: Check final presentation against actual study results

incremental.description: Maintain presentation templates and chart-export settings

approvals.approved_version: approved final presentation; revised slides return to s3
checked final presentation follow-up note from s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only s2 changes: 25*(1-0.60)=10 gross hours per 100. One upkeep hour gives central net 9%; two additional hours correcting figure layouts gives high 7%. Zero if the current template already does this.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Obtain informed consent from subjects or guardians

steps.what: Prepare the correct approved consent information for the actual subject or guardian
inputs: verified subject identity and guardian details where applicable
outputs: correct consent packet with verified administrative fields

steps.what: Explain the study, participation choices and consent information to the subject or guardian
inputs: correct consent packet with verified administrative fields

steps.what: Answer questions and assess understanding and voluntary participation without making the subject's decision
inputs: subject or guardian's actual responses and choice
outputs: actual consent decision or unresolved issues

steps.what: Capture the actual consent choice, required signatures and any unresolved issues in the study consent form
inputs: actual consent decision or unresolved issues
actual subject or guardian signature if consenting

steps.what: Verify the final consent record matches the person's actual choice and the approved study version
Commit the verified consent record to the study system
outputs: saved actual consent status and record

tasks.design: Configure approved version selection and administrative prefill in the study consent system {OPS_SYSTEM}. The assistant explains the study, checks understanding and records the person's actual decision; no tool infers consent from silence or from a scheduled appointment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Choosing a document version and repeating verified administrative details can precede the substantive consent conversation.
tasks.enabler_now: A configured study form can select an approved version and reuse verified identity fields.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding, voluntariness, guardian authority and unexpected concerns need human attention.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant creates room for questions and recognises when to pause or refer an unresolved issue.

ambition.what: Keep consent personal while reducing limited administrative preparation.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2–5 for study governance, participant-data access and staff consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: electronic study forms can use approved versions and prefill verified administrative fields; consent conversations and actual choices still require people.

assumptions: This is a provisional 100-hour scenario, not a measured baseline or legal protocol.
The study's approved consent procedure governs identity, signatures, information and record retention.
Identity and guardian details must already be verified; missing or disputed details are resolved by the assistant, not inferred.
Capture of actual consent and signatures is explicitly retained in s4. No saving is assigned to the same-system commit in s6.
Any participant copy transmission is a separate gated action if required by the local protocol; no mailing saving is assumed here.
Use existing study-system configuration first; already automated preparation yields no additional saving.
research_questions: Is administrative prefill permitted and is it already present?

already_counted.description: Verify the completed consent record and actual choice

incremental.description: Maintain approved version rules and inspect prefill exceptions

approvals.approved_version: approved final actual consent record; any change returns to s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only preparation changes: 10*(1-0.50)=5 gross hours. One upkeep hour gives central net 4%; one extra hour resolving mismatched identity fields gives high 3%. Low zero if preparation is already configured. No conversation, signature or save saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Administer tests or interview research subjects

steps.what: Prepare the correct standardized test or interview instrument and permitted branching
inputs: approved study instrument and administration rules
verified subject eligibility and session details

steps.what: Administer the test or conduct the interview under the study's actual administration rules
outputs: actual interview answers or test responses and administration deviations

steps.what: Capture actual responses and deviations in the study's structured research data form
inputs: actual interview answers or test responses and administration deviations
approved field definitions and permitted answer codes
outputs: complete actual session response draft with explicit missing answers

steps.what: Check the complete response record for fidelity, missing answers and instrument deviations
inputs: complete actual session response draft with explicit missing answers
actual interview answers or test responses and administration deviations

steps.what: Save the approved session responses to the study dataset

tasks.design: Configure the approved instrument, permitted routing and response validation in the study data-collection system {OPS_SYSTEM}. The assistant still administers the test or interview and captures actual answers; structured fields reduce field selection and format correction without inventing missing responses.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selecting instrument versions and correcting avoidable response-format errors can interrupt data collection.
tasks.enabler_now: Native study forms can enforce permitted routing, answer formats and explicit missing-value codes.
tasks.still_hard: Rapport, standardized delivery and deciding how to handle an unexpected response remain with the assistant.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant recognises distress, ambiguity and departures from valid administration.

ambition.what: Collect the approved data more consistently without changing the instrument or participant interaction.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2–5 for protocol review, subject-data access and staff consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: research data forms can use version control, conditional routing and answer validation while retaining actual participant response capture.

assumptions: Shares and remaining effort are provisional scenario inputs, not measured interview or testing baselines.
Study governance permits this data-collection medium and routing; changing standardized administration requires separate approval.
The assistant captures actual answers in s3; no upstream transcript, inferred answer or free data producer is assumed.
Only routing setup and field-format correction change. Native features are checked first and saves receive no saving.
Consent is a separate workflow, not presumed from attendance; do not add overlapping study-administration tasks blindly in a role roll-up.
unknowns: Whether instruments allow the proposed electronic form
research_questions: Do field selection and format correction remain material after native configuration?

already_counted.description: Check actual answers, missingness and administration deviations

incremental.description: Maintain approved instrument versions, routing and validation rules

approvals.approved_version: approved final session response record; edits return to s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 4 hours in s1 plus 5 in s3 =9 per 100. One upkeep hour gives central net 8%; two more hours handling instrument exceptions gives high 6%. Low zero if native forms already provide this. No saving in administering the instrument or saving the record.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
